notes.title: Update 1.1.2 is LIVE! Rift DK2 Support & More!
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://digitaltribegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/08/Qbeh-1_Update_1-1-2.png[/IMG]

QB-1 VR fans have been clamoring for DK2 support ever since Oculus Rift support was announced AND NOW IT'S HERE!  

[i]Qbeh-1: The Atlas Cube[/i] has now updated to the newest Oculus Rift SDK, which has better support for DK2.

Mac gamers can rejoice as well as OSX gets the Rift support and demo in this update too!

See the full Changelog here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/252550/discussions/0/540742579548648274/

notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Initial release of the Rift support had some ugly blurriness to it which was somewhat caused by the antialiasing method we used (FXAA). This patch adds a new antialiasing method (SMAA) which will also look much better in the regular mode.

Check the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/252550/discussions/0/540742579548648274/]changelog[/url] for rest of the fixes.

notes.title: Mac version released!
notes.notes:
[h1]We are happy to announce that Qbeh-1 has finally found its way to your Steam powered Mac![/h1]

We here at Digital Tribe and Liquid Flower could not let PC gamers have all the fun so are happy to announce that the [b]QBEH-1: The Atlas Cube[/b] Mac version is now available on Steam.

[b]QBEH-1: The Atlas Cube[/b] is an atmospheric 1st-person puzzle platformer that takes players on an inspired quest through a variety of divergent worlds, each filled with new mysteries and secrets to uncover. In each world, players find special cubes that must be collected and used to navigate to the next portal.

Now the Mac gaming community can see why journalists the world over are giving [b]Qbeh-1: The Atlas Cube[/b] scores like 4.5/5, 90/100 and 10/10.

“[i]A simple idea has been taken and turned into a complex puzzle game, with stunning visuals and relaxing music. If you've not played this great indie title yet, I highly suggest you give it a go![/i]”
-	Glacier Gaming | 10/10

“[i]Qbeh-1 is a beautifully crafted atmospheric puzzle adventure that is one of the first "must have" indie titles of the year[/i]”
-	GAMbit Magazine | 4.5/5

“[i]...if you are fans of Zelda’s puzzles, Portal’s genius, and a nice state of zen, there isn’t a better time to jump into this game than now.[/i]”
-	Mod Vive | 90/100

“[i]It’s peaceful, intellectually rewarding, and of all things a stress reliever. Qbeh-1: The Atlas Cube, is great.[/i]”
-	Hooked Gamers | 9/10

It is not just the gaming media that are falling in love with [i]QBEH-1: The Atlas Cube[/i] either! User reviews on Steam are filled with thumbs up “recommended” where players are calling the game “[i]almost magical with the brilliant level and sound design[/i]”, “[i]an awesome labor of love[/i]”, “[i]incredibly beautiful[/i]” and “[i]simply amazing[/i]”.

[b]FEATURES[/b][list]
  [*]Solve elaborate puzzles using a variety of Cube types such as Building Blocks, Energy Cubes and Gravity Manipulators 
  [*]Explore atmospheric Worlds, each with 6 challenging levels and unique themes 
  [*]Discover alternate paths, intriguing platforming elements and secrets to unlock an unfolding mystery 
  [*]Experience an immersive & mesmerizing Soundtrack that pulls you into the adventure 
[/list]
The inspiring [b]QBEH-1: The Atlas Cube[/b] original soundtrack by Launchable Socks, including never before heard bonus tracks, can be found and purchased on Bandcamp: http://launchablesocks.bandcamp.com/album/qbeh-1-ost

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 + Free Soundtrack!
notes.notes:
We've just released the first update to Qbeh-1.
You can find the changelog in the forums.

This update also has the official soundtrack bundled with it.
The soundtrack will be available with the game until May 29th 2014.
You can find the soundtrack in the game's folder, which you can access like this, for example:
[list]
[*]Right Click on Qbeh­1: The Atlas Cube in your Library
[*]Select Properties
[*]Click on LOCAL FILES tab
[*]Click on BROWSE LOCAL FILES
[*]Here you will see a folder called “Soundtrack”
[*]Copy & Paste this folder to your Music folder
[*]You now own the Qbeh­1 OST!
[/list]
